lines.text: A Poké Flute awakens sleeping Pokémon.\nIt does so with a sound that only they can hear.
Psst. The woman with the Abra at the corner\nover there...\c\nRumor has it that she’s an amazing fortune-teller!
If I had a Pokémon, I would go to\nPokémon Road, too!
There’s a magazine called Pokémon Best Spots.

“The amazing spot we’re introducing this time is
Pokémon Road!\c
“It’s the sloping road that connects Celadon City
and Fuchsia City!\c
“During the weekend, many Trainers walk around
with their Pokémon on Pokémon Road.\c
“Sometimes, Pokémon that become friends there
become matchmakers for their Trainers...or not.”
